repo.description:
## Impact

A dynamic-path webhook URL contains a server-generated identifier that is the only unguessable part of it. Webhook resolution matched on the path alone and ran first, so a request omitting that identifier still resolved to the workflow and executed it. An unauthenticated caller can run a workflow in a project they have no relationship with, under that project's credentials. The same resolver serves the form and MCP routes. Node-level authentication still applies.

## Patches

The issue has been fixed in n8n versions 1.123.83, 2.42.1 and 2.41.4. Users should upgrade to one of these versions or later to remediate the vulnerability.

## Workarounds

If upgrading is not immediately possible, administrators should consider the following temporary mitigations:
- Restrict n8n instance access to fully trusted users only.
- Enable node-level webhook authentication (Basic, Header, or JWT) on all active Webhook nodes that use dynamic path templates.
- Deactivate workflows using dynamic-path webhooks until the instance is patched.
- Apply network-level controls to restrict access to the `/webhook/*`, `/form/*`, and `/mcp/*` routes to trusted sources only.

These workarounds do not fully remediate the risk and should only be used as short-term mitigation measures.
repo.summary: Unauthenticated Cross-Project Workflow Execution via Webhook Path-Only Resolution
